newsitem.title: CANADA: Quebec's Bouchard to join Canada's trade mission.
newsitem.headline: Quebec's Bouchard to join Canada's trade mission.

text.p: Quebec Premier Lucien Bouchard will join the Canadian government's trade mission to Asia scheduled for January, his press secretary said on Thursday.
"It is highly probable that Mr. Bouchard will go there, but there are still ongoing discussions about the schedule," Isabelle Rondeau told Reuters.

If Bouchard participates in Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien's "Team Canada" mission, it will be the first time that Quebec's separatist Parti Quebecois government joins other Canadian provincial premiers on such a mission. Bouchard's predecessor as Quebec premier and party leader, Jacques Parizeau, refused to participate in similar federal government-led trade missions to China in 1994 and India in 1995.
During the trade tour, set for January 8 to 20, Chretien will lead the group on visits to South Korea, the Philippines and Thailand.
